motivation: Reviewer-requested Development-only retuning and complete reporting of the six approximate-unlearning baselines.

frozen_prior_boundary.policy: Stage 7 cannot change the adverse Stage 3--6 conclusions or select hyperparameters from attack, sequential, storage, or FinalTest outcomes.

development_partition.rule: For Development index i with authoritative user u and binary label y, SHA256(['ali-stage7-dev-split-v1',42,u,y,i]) interpreted as an integer is assigned to Dev-Fit when even and Dev-Select when odd.

stage7a_screen.primary_selection_quantity: Equal-scenario mean Dev-Select E_U, where E_U is mean absolute Yes-probability error to Exact-Masked on requested-user examples.
stage7a_screen.selection_rule: Among candidates passing both utility guardrails in both scenarios, minimize equal-scenario mean E_U. Break exact ties by fewer optimizer/HVP calls, then canonical candidate id. If none passes, record NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE and do not silently promote a failed candidate.
stage7a_screen.artifact_retention: All candidate metrics, configurations and model-state hashes are permanent. To bound storage, non-selected candidate model tensors may be discarded after verified evaluation; the deterministically selected evaluated candidate artifacts are retained.

stage7b_confirmation.policy: Stage 7B is a cross-seed Development confirmation. Any later FinalTest rerun requires a separate dated amendment and cannot be described as the original untouched one-shot evaluation.

interpretation_rules: All candidates and adverse outcomes must be retained and reported.
Normalized residual is descriptive and is not the primary selector because the Original--Exact denominator is approximately 2e-4.
Retain-Retrain-P5 and attack outcomes are excluded from model selection.
The sweep may strengthen a baseline and therefore may narrow or overturn comparative BOTA claims.
No paper result or claim is changed until Stage 7A and any authorized Stage 7B audit are complete.
